document.title: Operator Health Check — 2026-03-12 14:51 UTC
document.content:
# Operator Health Check

Time: 2026-03-12 14:51 UTC

## Summary
- PM2: Mostly healthy; 12 online, 1 stopped (`whisper`).
- Docker: Most containers running, but 3 degraded (`langfuse_langfuse-web_1` restarting, `lidaros-frontend-1` unhealthy, `omiximo-email-automation` unhealthy).
- Disk: `/` at 69% usage (within threshold).
- Memory: 11.3 GB used / 27.5 GB total, ~41% used (within threshold).
- GPU: RTX 4090 present; 20.6 GB / 24.6 GB VRAM in use by `VLLM::EngineCore`; 0% utilization at sample time.
- OpenClaw gateway: Responding on 127.0.0.1:18789, but `openclaw gateway status` reports the systemd service as inactive/sub dead with outdated non-standard service config embedding a token.

## PM2
Online: agent-log, gpu-router, iam-chat-proxy, kira-admin, kira-app, kira-dashboard, oopuo-website, openclaw-bridge, openclaw-gateway, stella-tax, whatsapp-bridge, zenithcred-website.
Stopped: whisper.

## Docker
Healthy/running core services observed, including IAM staging nginx, IAM Ghost/MySQL, omiximo inventory stack, ollama, n8n, Evolution API, and Nomad-managed app containers.

Degraded containers:
- `langfuse_langfuse-web_1` — restarting
- `lidaros-frontend-1` — unhealthy
- `omiximo-email-automation` — unhealthy

## Resources
- Disk `/`: 452G used / 662G total / 210G available (69%).
- RAM: 11,285 MB used / 27,532 MB total; no swap configured.
- GPU: 20,550 MiB / 24,564 MiB VRAM used by `VLLM::EngineCore`; temperature 43C; power 21W.

## OpenClaw Gateway
- Bind: 127.0.0.1:18789
- RPC probe: OK
- Listening: yes
- Service manager view: inactive / sub dead / last exit 203
- Config warning: service appears out of date and embeds `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN`
- Recommendation from tooling: run `openclaw doctor` or `openclaw doctor --repair`; reinstall service with `openclaw gateway install --force` if systemd is still the intended control plane

## Assessment
System resources are fine. Main concerns are service consistency and degraded app containers, not host capacity.
